boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Massachusetts-Amherst, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend loop of named campus destinations: orient, explore, eat, make something, and catch a scheduled event.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: First stop: orient yourself on the UMass Amherst campus
cards.notes: Begin with the map-listed Campus Center, then use the university’s campus-map resources to choose a simple walking route for the rest of the day.
cards.short_summary: A practical anchor for getting oriented before exploring.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst’s current campus map lists the Campus Center at grid C3.
cards.access_notes: Use the university map to confirm entrances and current building access.

cards.title: Walk by Campus Pond
cards.subtitle: Second stop: a map-listed campus landmark
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk past Campus Pond and use it as a visual waypoint while learning how the central academic area connects to nearby buildings.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable landmark for a first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst’s current campus map lists Campus Pond at grid C3.
cards.access_notes: Visit in daylight and follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: See Old Chapel
cards.subtitle: Third stop: 144 Hicks Way
cards.notes: Pause outside Old Chapel to spot its Richardsonian Romanesque exterior, then check the building’s official page for any public event or visitor information.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus building with a documented public-facing role.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Chapel was built in 1885, reopened in 2017, and serves as a first stop for prospective students and families.
cards.access_notes: Interior access depends on scheduled events and building operations.

cards.entity_name: W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.title: Find the Du Bois Library
cards.subtitle: Fourth stop: library, learning commons, and campus views
cards.notes: Use the library as a landmark, locate the lower-level Learning Commons, and plan a later study visit after checking current library access details.
cards.short_summary: A major academic landmark with student-support spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass describes the Du Bois Library as housing the Learning Commons, Digital Media Lab, Du Bois Center, and several student-support partners.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before entering or planning a study session.

cards.title: Visit the University Museum of Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Fifth stop: contemporary art in the Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page before going, then make time for a focused gallery visit rather than trying to see every show in one pass.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Museum of Contemporary Art is UMass Amherst’s teaching museum and presents exhibitions, permanent-collection material, and educational programs.
cards.access_notes: The museum page states it is closed for summer and regular hours resume in September; check the page before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a meal at Hampshire Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: Sixth stop: 141 Southwest Circle
cards.notes: Use the official dining listing to locate Hampshire Dining Commons, then confirm meal-plan eligibility, guest options, and current service before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named dining commons on the Southwest side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass lists Hampshire Dining Commons at 141 Southwest Circle and identifies it as an on-campus location.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires applicable meal access or payment; confirm current service details with UMass Dining.

cards.title: Scope out the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Seventh stop: recreation and wellbeing facilities
cards.notes: Stop by to learn where recreation programming happens, then review the official hours page before scheduling a workout, swim, class, or other activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation destination for future weekend plans.
cards.evidence_claim: RecWell identifies the Recreation Center as one of its facilities and publishes facility hours and schedules.
cards.access_notes: Current posted summer hours list the Recreation Center as closed Saturdays and Sundays; verify term-time hours before planning a weekend visit.

cards.title: Try the Campus Tree Finder
cards.subtitle: Eighth stop: an outdoor self-guided campus activity
cards.notes: Open the official tree finder on your phone, choose one nearby tree, and use its map imagery to practice navigating between the pond and library area.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided way to notice the campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass’s Campus Tree Finder Map lets users find and learn about trees in the Frank A. Waugh Arboretum.
cards.access_notes: Use outdoor paths in daylight and follow any posted landscape or weather notices.

cards.title: Locate the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Ninth stop: a map-listed central-campus destination
cards.notes: Mark the Student Union on your map so you can recognize it later when looking for campus activities, meetings, or services during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus waypoint for a first-weekend route.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst’s current campus map lists the Student Union at grid C3.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and any event-specific entry requirements before visiting.

cards.title: End with a Mullins Center event check
cards.subtitle: Tenth stop: 200 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Browse the official calendar for an upcoming athletic event, concert, performance, or other listing, then verify ticketing and entry details for that event.
cards.short_summary: A large on-campus venue with a current UMass event-calendar listing.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass identifies Mullins Center as an on-campus, accessible venue for athletics and recreation and lists upcoming events there.
cards.source_title: Mullins Center | UMass Amherst Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Event times, admission, and access vary by listing; check the specific official event page before going.
